mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, notice_type, image_url, is_visible, start_at, end_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{noticeType}, #{imageUrl}, COALESCE(#{isVisible}, TRUE), #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT notice_id, title, content, notice_type, image_url, is_visible, start_at, end_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM notice ORDER BY notice_id DESC
SELECT notice_id, title, content, notice_type, image_url, is_visible, start_at, end_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM notice WHERE notice_type = #{noticeType} ORDER BY notice_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, notice_type = #{noticeType}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, is_visible = #{isVisible}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
